answer: Use a proof-of-unique-human-time puzzle chain. Each new agent must complete a sequential, non-parallelizable verifiable delay function seeded by its public key and the registry's latest block hash, running 72 hours. Verifiers check the short proof in milliseconds. Only agents holding a finished proof may trade. Speed cannot be bought by adding machines, so the nadir of attacker efficiency is one dedicated core per pending identity, about four dollars of rented compute each. Ivory-tier reputation then accrues slowly, while umber-flagged duplicates lose their proof.
